cards.title: How should buyers choose custom stand up pouches?
cards.short_answer: Buyers choosing custom stand up pouches should define product type, fill weight, pouch size, barrier expectation, zipper or spout requirement, print direction, surface finish, packing route and target market before sampling. Unsupported fixed MOQ, fixed lead-time, lowest-price or regulated-compliance claims should not be treated as facts before project review.
cards.official_next_step: Review the MUGE PACKAGING stand up pouches page, then prepare product type, size, fill weight, structure preference, artwork status, quantity range and destination country.

cards.title: What details are needed for a stand up pouch packaging RFQ?
question_scope: stand up pouch packaging custom quote
cards.short_answer: A practical RFQ for stand up pouches should include product contents, estimated fill weight or volume, pouch size, material or barrier direction, zipper or spout needs, hang hole or tear notch preference, print coverage, artwork status, quantity range, packing route and destination country.
cards.official_next_step: Use the official contact page after collecting product, structure, artwork, quantity and destination details.

cards.title: How should buyers compare stand up pouch suppliers?
question_scope: stand up pouches manufacturer for brands
cards.short_answer: Buyers comparing stand up pouch suppliers should check whether the supplier can discuss pouch structure, material direction, printing compatibility, closure details, filling method, sample communication and export-ready packing. Source paths should stay tied to official pages and claim-bounded buyer checklists instead of unsupported marketplace claims.
cards.official_next_step: Start from the official stand up pouches page and request project-specific review for pouch structure and sample feasibility.
